mapper.sql: t.id, t.name, t.title_hint, t.category_id, t.blocks_json, t.layout_json, t.created_by, t.created_at, t.updated_at, u.name AS creator_name, c.name AS category_name
FROM post_templates t LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = t.created_by LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_templates (name, title_hint, category_id, blocks_json, layout_json, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{titleHint}, #{categoryId}, #{blocksJson}, #{layoutJson}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE post_templates SET name = #{name}, title_hint = #{titleHint}, category_id = #{categoryId}, blocks_json = #{blocksJson}, layout_json = #{layoutJson}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
